runs.answer:
[Turn 1 | session=ses_0e75b04f1ffe5Fj5phDlctTOd4] Query the first-seen block arrival times for mainnet blocks on 20 June 2026 (UTC).
Query executed successfully. Here are the results:

**Dataset:** `mainnet.fct_block_first_seen_by_node` (xatu-cbt)  
**Date:** 20 June 2026 UTC  
**Total blocks:** 7,180 (slots ~14,597,336 to ~14,597,998)

Each row contains per-block arrival metrics (in milliseconds from slot start):

| Column | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `slot` | Beacon slot number |
| `slot_start_date_time` | Wall clock time when slot started |
| `block_root` | Block root hash |
| `first_seen_arrival_ms` | Earliest arrival time across all nodes |
| `avg_arrival_ms` | Average arrival across all nodes |
| `nodes_observed` | Number of nodes that reported seeing the block |

| slot | time | first_seen_arrival_ms | avg_arrival_ms | nodes |

| 14597337 | 00:00:23 | 1,226 | 1,415 | 157 |
| 14597338 | 00:00:35 | 1,266 | 1,458 | 157 |
| ... | ... | ... | ... | ... |

**URL:** http://127.0.0.1:2480/api/v1/storage/files/ca7df23be98f/f9bf5d83-3f0e-48a1-b4af-14275d5c4028/arrival_distribution.png
